basic.name: Hundred Rockets
basic.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{main_damage}}% of Tribbie's Max HP to one designated enemy. Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{adjacent_damage}}% of Tribbie's Max HP to adjacent targets.

skill.name: Where'd the Gifts Go
skill.description_template: Gains "Numinosity," lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While Tribbie has "Numinosity," increases all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN by {{res_pen}}%.

ultimate.name: Guess Who Lives Here
ultimate.description_template:
Activates a Zone and deals Quantum DMG equal to {{initial_damage}}% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies.
While the Zone lasts, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by {{zone_dmg_taken}}%. After an ally target attacks, for every 1 target hit, deals 1 instance of Quantum Additional DMG equal to {{zone_additional_damage}}% of Tribbie's Max HP to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets.
The Zone lasts for 2 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn.

talent.name: Busy as Tribbie
talent.description_template: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches a Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to {{follow_up_damage}}% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters. If the target was defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is launched, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against new enemy targets entering the battlefield.

technique.name: If You're Happy and You Know It
technique.description: After using Technique and upon entering battle, obtains "Numinosity," lasting for 3 turn(s).

2.name: Lamb Outside the Wall...
2.description: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increases the DMG dealt by Tribbie by 72%. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s), lasting for 3 turn(s).

4.name: Glass Ball with Wings!
4.description: While the Zone lasts, Tribbie's Max HP increases by an amount equal to 9% of the sum of all ally characters' Max HP.

6.name: Pebble at Crossroads?
6.description: At the start of battle, Tribbie regenerates 30 Energy. After other ally targets attack, Tribbie regenerates 1.5 Energy for each target hit.

eidolons.name: Rite of Sugar Scoop
eidolons.description: While the Zone lasts and after ally targets attack enemies, additionally deals True DMG equal to 24% of the total DMG of this attack to targets that have been dealt Additional DMG by the Zone.

eidolons.name: Guide of Dream Tour
eidolons.description: The Additional DMG dealt by the Zone increases to 120% of the original DMG. When the Zone deals Additional DMG, further deals 1 instance(s) of Additional DMG.

eidolons.name: Trove of Morning Glow
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Peace of Empathy Bond
eidolons.description: While "Numinosity" lasts, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores 18% of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Clock of Wonder Origin
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Morrow of Star Shine
eidolons.description: After Tribbie uses Ultimate, launches her Talent's Follow-Up ATK against all enemies. The DMG dealt by Talent's Follow-Up ATK increases by 729%.
